OUT OF SCOPE, FOUND, NOT FIXED — a real defect in tools/land.mjs: its generated-file conflict policy ('theirs wins, regenerated next commit') can pin a generated file to a stale version permanently. orchestration/INDEX.md was stuck at the old 205,751-byte version through three consecutive lands because every attempt conflicted and theirs won each time, while nothing on the branch regenerates outside a hook that land.mjs bypasses. I broke the loop with `git reset --mixed origin/<branch>` (the same call land.mjs makes internally at line 331 — NOT --hard, so no working-tree file was touched) and the small INDEX landed cleanly. The policy is right in general and wrong when the fleet lands exclusively through land.mjs/bank.mjs. Worth a piece.
